date: Nov 17, 2026 · Week 2 / Day 2 · Decision-driven meetings and tradeoffs

cards.title: Who actually makes the call?
cards.question: PCIe margin misses target, but SI and layout both believe the other team owns the fix. How do you unblock the review?
cards.selfCheck: Name the accountable decision-maker, evidence owners and escalation deadline. Exercise: close the meeting with one decision owner and two dated deliverables.
cards.prompt: Role-play a PCIe Gen5 design review where SI and layout disagree on ownership. Challenge me to establish decision rights without claiming authority I do not have.

cards.title: Compare risk, not just dB
cards.question: A connector change improves insertion loss by 0.5 dB but increases mechanical and sourcing risk. What should decide?
cards.selfCheck: Compare system margin, validation confidence, supply impact and schedule in one option table. Exercise: make a conditional recommendation and state what would reverse it.
cards.prompt: Give me a realistic connector change decision with SI, mechanical and sourcing stakeholders. Test whether my recommendation weighs total system risk rather than just S21.

cards.title: A model is not a vote
cards.question: Two EM models predict acceptable via performance, but one calibrated TDR measurement disagrees. How do you move forward?
cards.selfCheck: Check reference planes, bandwidth, fixture de-embedding and model assumptions; define the decisive correlation test. Exercise: state what is known, suspected and still unproven in 25 seconds.
cards.prompt: Play skeptical measurement and modeling leads in a via EM/TDR disagreement. Help me frame uncertainty and choose a discriminating experiment before signoff.

cards.title: Turn disagreement into a gate
cards.question: A 20 MHz PDN peak concerns PI, while the power architect says the load profile makes it harmless. What meeting outcome matters?
cards.selfCheck: Agree on the relevant transient spectrum, allowable droop and validation method, then assign an owner and date. Exercise: write a pass/fail gate both teams can accept.
cards.prompt: Simulate a PDN signoff debate between PI and power architecture. Ask me to establish a shared load-transient acceptance criterion and a concrete test owner.

cards.title: Leave with a decision log
cards.question: A crosstalk mitigation review ends with 'we'll investigate.' What did the meeting fail to produce?
cards.selfCheck: Record decision or deferral reason, alternatives, risk accepted, owner and next checkpoint. Exercise: deliver a 40-second closeout and identify the escalation trigger.
cards.prompt: Coach my 40-second closeout for a NEXT violation near layout freeze. Evaluate decision clarity, owner, due date, residual risk and escalation threshold.
